description: This file is a shell script designed to test error handling in a Git upload-pack implementation. It contains functions and test cases that simulate corrupt repositories and various failure scenarios during the upload-pack process, such as errors in pack-objects, rev-list, and object existence checks.

methods.name: corrupt_repo
methods.description: Function to delete a specific object from the Git object database by computing the SHA1 and removing its directory, simulating corruption.
